seo.title: Terms of service | Avesta Tech
seo.description: The terms that apply to Avesta Tech quotes, fixed-price services and Avesta Proof: scope, payment, permission to scan, confidentiality and liability.

sections.heading: Terms of service
sections.sub: The terms that apply when you work with Avesta Tech.

sections.heading: Scope
paragraphs: These terms apply to every quote, agreement and service from Avesta Tech, KvK [KVK_NUMBER], including Avesta Proof subscriptions and fixed-price engineering services.

sections.heading: Quotes and fixed-price agreements
paragraphs: Every service has a written scope, a fixed price and a delivery date, agreed in writing before we start. Work outside the agreed scope needs a new written agreement. All prices exclude 21% Dutch BTW.

sections.heading: Permission to scan
paragraphs: We scan or test only systems and code for which you have given written permission, and only within the agreed scope. You confirm that you are entitled to give that permission.

sections.heading: Confidentiality
paragraphs: We keep your code, findings and business information confidential and use them only to deliver the service. Avesta Proof runs in your environment; we see results, not source, unless you choose to share it.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
paragraphs: Once paid, the deliverables made for you (reports, test suites, configuration and documentation) are yours to use. Avesta Proof itself, our tools and our general know-how remain ours.

sections.heading: Audit-ready evidence, not certification
paragraphs: Avesta provides audit-ready evidence. We do not certify products, we do not make conformity decisions and we do not give legal advice. Certification is issued only by accredited bodies; legal questions belong with your counsel.

sections.heading: Liability
paragraphs: Our liability is limited to [LIABILITY_CAP], except in the case of intent or gross negligence.

sections.heading: Governing law
paragraphs: Dutch law applies. Disputes go to the competent court in Utrecht [CONFIRM_FORUM].
